report_title: Final commitment: exact fixing and substitution
shape: source 36864 vars / 33791 rows / 135156 nonzeros (110580 x-coefficients +1, 24576 c-coefficients -1) / 36864 integers / all bounds UP 1; target 36864 vars / 33791 rows / 110580 nonzeros, objective c0+c1+c2+c3 byte-for-byte unchanged; solver original Time limit reached/4 -> reformulated Optimal/4
edit_summary: Four activations are proved forced: every integer feasible point has c0=c1=c2=c3=1, by a bounded local 12-vertex coloring refutation (add proof-only edge (1,3), contract triangle 1-2-3, all six perfect matchings of the resulting cubic graph leave two 5-cycles). The edit then rewrites the four bound records UP 1 -> FX 1, deletes the -1 coefficient of c_k from all 24576 linking Le rows (6144 per color) and rewrites those rows' RHS 0 -> 1, so they read sum(incident x of one color) <= 1. All 9215 equalities, all 24576 +1 x coefficients, x bounds, integrality, senses and every objective coefficient are untouched; the four fixed columns remain as objective carriers keeping the constant objective 4. Strictly shape-preserving: no column or row added or deleted, 36864/33791 on both sides, only 24,584 records change.
claims: A single certificate holds 2 claims (forward, reverse) of a full-joint reformulation with objective 'Equal' and the identity projection over all 36,864 coordinates (inverse pairing [1,0]); the forward claim carries input_objective_lower='4' and there is 1 point claim Feasible{target:false, integers:true, objective:'4'} built from an actually constructed 4-edge-coloring. Forward and reverse mirror the same substitution: the forward direction drops each -1 coefficient using c_k<=1 (VarUpper) while the reverse restores it using c_k>=1 (VarLower), so both halves of the fixed domain are consumed.
proof_encoding: proof.rpa = 'RPA 6' header plus one JSON body of 15,703,666 B: claims 1,135,479 B (identical to the request.json claims) + points 184,412 B + 2 blocks; request.json is 988,085 B and repeats the same 36,864-pair identity projection

block 0 (forward) 8,442,011 B, 24,633 top-level steps = 52 packing/reduced Lin rows (original row combined with VarLower of external vertices), 4 Cases carrying the whole local refutation (116 nested Cases, 2,892 nested Lin facts, 236 nodes, depth 6) and 24,576 Lin steps of shape {terms:[[RowUpper r,1],[VarUpper c_k,1]], constant:0}, closed by one Lin step combining Local 52/805/1558/2311 into the objective lower bound 4

block 1 (reverse) 7,965,138 B, 24,580 Lin steps = 4 VarLower-only steps (c_k>=1) plus 24,576 Lin steps {terms:[[RowUpper r,1],[VarLower c_k,1]], constant:0}, one per substituted row, mirroring the forward deletion

obligations 436,225 = 218,113 forward + 218,112 reverse; per claim 110,592 column checks (VarLower/VarUpper/VarInt, the 4 activations' VarLower replaced by the fixing fact), 33,791 row checks (RowEq x 9215 plus Local x 24576/24580), then 73,729 bare 'Exact' markers for the 1+2*36864 identity-projection obligations

verify statistics: obligations 436,225, linear_terms 238,176, peak_live_facts 24,633, branches 120, all lift counters zero; exit 0 VERIFIED with 2 claims and 1 point; the 15.7 MB RPA assembles to a 10.5 MB RPX
agent_manual_work: Two independent exact MPS parsers written by hand (persistent workspace parser plus the 189-line output/verify.py), both using Fraction built from decimal tokens, both rejecting unsupported sections; verify.py re-derives the whole edit and prints status PASS

Incidence graph rebuilt from the parsed matrix: 9215 equalities x 4 colors, 24576 linking rows, 6144 color-row groups, 6142 degree-3 and 2 degree-2 vertices, no parallel edges, one component, 511 bridges and 512 blocks of 12 via hand-written Tarjan

The decisive local certificate invented by hand: parity forces vertices 1 and 3 to miss the same color, proof-only edge (1,3) makes the local graph cubic, contracting triangle (1,2,3) leaves 15 edges, all C(15,5)=3,003 subsets enumerated and exactly six perfect matchings found, all with complement cycles [5,5]

The transformation performed as raw MPS line surgery (bound records rewritten UP->FX, coefficient records dropped, 24,576 RHS records appended) with audit.json recording every affected row, removed coefficient and RHS change

An actual 4-coloring of the 9,215-edge graph constructed by hand (per-block backtracking search, block-tree BFS permuting colors across the 511 bridges) and asserted against all 33,791 rows - the Feasible point at objective 4 that certifies attainment

friction: The edit is not consumed as data: the preparer re-parses source and target MPS and re-discovers the control column by scanning the source row terms (tools/prepare_test67.py:163) even though the agent's audit.json already carries bounds_changes, substitutions{c0..c3: fixed_value 1, removed_coefficient -1, rows 6144} and rhs_changes{rows 24576, old 0, new 1}; no kernel API accepts such a record

Everything is spelled out element by element: 24,576 near-identical two-term Lin steps per direction, 218k checks per claim, 73,729 'Exact' markers, a 36,864-pair identity projection written into both request.json and the RPA, and a 36,864-entry identity Return map (1,610,906 B per block) - no loop, range or identity shorthand exists
Cost is invisible before assembly: nothing tells the caller this plan needs 436,225 obligations, 24,633 live facts and 120 branches, or that the reverse direction costs one extra Lin step per row

The refutation and the feasible point come from hand-written search inside the preparer (refute line 27, color_point line 67); the kernel only checks the resulting Lin/Cases/Absurd subtree and the point values, so both the four fixings and the attainment of objective 4 depend on home-grown enumeration code

Failure reports are thin at this size: the recorded negative results are only {message:'INVALID contradiction witness'} and {message:'INVALID obligation mismatch: expected Le; obligation 144382'} with no claim, block or step pointer, and the 15.4 KB preparation.json is the only place naming the four mutations
